title: Holy Ape Seizes the Goddess
summary: The 'Qilin' turns out to be a seed of the Qilin Divine Medicine, which could revive a cultivator whose lifespan has run out, and Ye Fan wins round two. The Red Dragon Daoist, the Green Dragon King and Tu Tian come to watch. In the final round Nangong cuts a Blood Sacrifice Altar stone from a forbidden region and reveals a goddess from an ancient royal clan, impaled and sealed by a spear, over whom the Ancient Divine Silkworm weeps. Ye Fan follows the dragon vein to an 'Immortal Tomb' stone hidden under the lake and cuts it with his Black-Gold Dragon-Pattern sword. A golden Battle Saint Ape of the ancient royal clans bursts out, uses a nine-fold heavenly transformation and escapes through a dimensional gate, and Nangong is left complaining that Ye Fan's carelessness cost him a priceless treasure. Ye Fan wins on earlier rounds, but at the celebration he collapses. Doctor Wang Shen says the heavenly law has cut his life force, a Great Dao wound that leaves him half a year at most, and Ye Fan asks Pang Bo to care for his parents on Earth if he dies.
